classification: post-hoc satellite-cap portfolio test after R341 fixed 5x concentration but diluted A+B performance and failed two recent fresh starts
hypothesis: Capping the broad R340 sleeve at a 10% satellite share of the equity risk budget preserves most A+B performance while retaining enough independent profit breadth to pass the 5x C2-C4 concentration gates and restore recent fresh-start stability.
disclosure: R341 used uncapped three-way inverse-vol risk parity; realized C mean weight was 35.81%. It passed all 5x cost and concentration gates but failed the pre-registered A+B incremental gate and two fresh starts. A post-result diagnostic over C caps found that 10%-20% still retained 5x top5 concentration near 63%-66%, while 10%-15% made both recent fresh starts positive. R342 freezes a 10% C satellite cap and also requires a cap plateau so the conclusion is not based on one weight.

fixed_construction.sleeve_weighting: monthly 60-day inverse-volatility risk parity across A/B/C with original [0.20,0.60] bounds; then cap C at 10% and redistribute excess proportionally to A and B
fixed_construction.overlay: 60-day lookback, 15% balance-vol target, gross [0.2,1.0], no leverage

data.D1: all sleeves load and produce full curves

tradeoff_vs_two_sleeve_control.G9_purpose: accept a small performance give-up only if 5x concentration survives

concentration.C12: max weight sum <=1, min target weight >=0

robustness.F1_fresh: at least 4/5 fresh starts positive and every MDD >= -18%
robustness.P1_overlay: >=7/9 overlay lookback/target variants pass core gates
robustness.P2_joint: >=2/3 joint target variants pass core gates

satellite_cap_plateau.per_cap_core: 2x annual >=12%, 2x Sharpe >=1.25, 2x MDD >= -15%; 5x annual >=10%, 5x Sharpe >=1.10, 5x MDD >= -15%; 5x C2-C4 pass; at least 4/5 fresh starts positive
satellite_cap_plateau.P4: at least 3/4 caps pass per-cap core and the 10% center passes

selection_rule: All D/G/X/C/R/F/P gates and P4 cap plateau must pass. Otherwise record negative result and do not promote. No threshold changes after results.
discipline: One center cap and one four-point plateau are specified before running R342.
No factor score, sleeve position count, holding period, overlay or asset grid is run.
No leverage; no paper target or order file.
known_limitations: The 10% center and cap plateau are informed by post-result R341 diagnostics.
Common window starts in 2023; not a full 2018-2026 validation.
C failed its standalone R340 gates and is used only as a small satellite.
Industry/financial snapshots and ETF qfq series are not full official PIT data.
